spec.rawSql: SELECT message_class, (CASE WHEN message_class = ANY (ah.conversation_classes()) THEN 'conversation' WHEN message_class = 'reasoning' THEN 'reasoning' ELSE 'harness-injected' END) AS content_group, count(*) AS messages, sum(octet_length(text)) AS bytes, round(avg(octet_length(text))) AS avg_bytes, sum(octet_length(text))::numeric / nullif(sum(sum(octet_length(text))) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM ah.message WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY bytes DESC NULLS LAST

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(l.ts, $bucket, NULL), CASE WHEN s.is_subagent THEN 'subagent' ELSE 'root' END AS metric, count(DISTINCT l.session_id) AS value FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND NOT s.is_subagent AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)))::numeric / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM ah.message WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ah.is_genuine_prompt(message_class, prompt_origin, text) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR agent IN ($agent))),0)

spec.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND NOT s.is_subagent AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)))::numeric / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM ah.subagent_spawn p JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = p.parent_session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))),0)

spec.description: Root LLM calls / subagent spawns. Falling = more delegation per orchestrator step.

options.content: **jg** (jevgrep) ranks the files that matter for a question using the Jev model through the Cloudflare AI Gateway; the `jevgrep` skill tells agents when to use it. Nothing extra is collected: a run is a Claude `Bash` call or Codex command whose command invokes `jg`, and the result is read from jg's own output. **complete** = ranked files returned, **incomplete** = Jev calls failed or were rate limited (Workers AI throttles Jev with 429s), **refused** = the wrapper blocked a backup repo, agent home or credential folder, **no jg output** = `jg` appeared in a command that never printed a jg message (a quoted mention, not a run) and is left out of the headline numbers. Admin runs (`jg doctor`, `jg --version`) are counted apart from searches. Panels stay empty until agents start using it.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT io.ts, io.namespace, io.agent, s.session_uid, ah.project_of(s.cwd) AS project, x.cmd, coalesce(c.duration_ms, o.duration_ms) AS duration_ms, coalesce(o.exit_code, c.exit_code) AS exit_code, CASE WHEN r.out !~ 'Jevgrep: [0-9]+ relevant files' AND x.cmd ~ '(^|[\s;&|(])jg\s+(doctor|auth|skill|--version|--help|-h)' THEN 'admin' ELSE 'search' END AS kind, CASE WHEN r.out LIKE '%jg: refusing to search%' THEN 'refused' WHEN r.out ~ 'Jevgrep: [0-9]+ relevant files; discovery incomplete' THEN 'incomplete' WHEN r.out ~ 'Jevgrep: [0-9]+ relevant files[.]' THEN 'complete' WHEN r.out LIKE '%Jev connection verified%' THEN 'doctor ok' WHEN r.out ~ '(Command failed[.] Check the root|Run jg auth|Jev connection check failed|jg: AGENT_CONTEXT|jg is not installed|Interrupted[.])' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'no jg output' END AS result, substring(r.out from 'Jevgrep: ([0-9]+) relevant files')::int AS files FROM ah.tool_io io JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = io.session_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(io.stdout_text,'') || coalesce(io.output_text,'') AS out) r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN NOT pg_input_is_valid(io.input_text, 'jsonb') THEN io.input_text WHEN jsonb_typeof(io.input_text::jsonb) = 'array' THEN io.input_text::jsonb->>-1 ELSE io.input_text::jsonb->>'command' END AS cmd) x LEFT JOIN ah.tool_call c ON io.kind = 'call' AND c.agent = io.agent AND c.call_uid = io.io_uid LEFT JOIN ah.tool_op o ON io.kind = 'op' AND o.agent = io.agent AND 'item:' || o.item_uid = io.io_uid WHERE $__timeFilter(io.ts) AND io.tool_name IN ('Bash','CommandExecution') AND io.input_text LIKE '%jg%' AND x.cmd ~ '(^|[\s;&|(])jg\s' AND s.session_uid <> 'a6080704-44be-4fdd-ad3e-5f890d0be3ee' AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR io.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR io.agent IN ($agent))) j WHERE kind = 'search' AND result <> 'no jg output' AND result = 'incomplete'

options.content: Type in **Search** above; **Match** picks all words, any word or the exact phrase; **Scope** searches the conversation (prompts, replies, briefs, reports, summaries) or everything, including reasoning and harness-injected text. **Tool I/O hits** search tool inputs, outputs, stdout and stderr. Panels marked **· ParadeDB** run on the ParadeDB BM25 indexes (`message_search_idx` over message text with the `source_code` tokenizer, `session_summary_search_idx` over journal summaries with English stemming): the `&&&` / `|||` / `###` match operators, `pdb.score` ranking, and `pdb.agg` facets computed from the index's columnar fast fields rather than by scanning rows. **Watch terms** trends several phrases at once. Semantic search needs a query embedding, so hybrid (BM25 + pgvector HNSW) stays in `agent-history search --hybrid` and the MCP. Click a session to open it in **Session drill-down**.

spec.description: Compactions per bucket by trigger (manual, auto, or blank for Codex).
spec.title: Compactions by trigger

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(spawn_depth,0)::text AS depth, count(*) AS sessions FROM ah.session WHERE $__timeFilter(first_event_at) AND is_subagent AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY spawn_depth ORDER BY spawn_depth

spec.description: Child sessions by nesting depth (1 = spawned by a root).
spec.title: Spawn depth

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg((p.completion_status='completed')::int) FROM ah.subagent_spawn p JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = p.parent_session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Share of spawns with completion_status=completed.
spec.title: Completed

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce(c.dropped_tokens, c.pre_tokens - c.post_tokens, 0)),0) FROM ah.compaction c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Sum of pre_tokens - post_tokens over compactions in range.
spec.title: Tokens dropped by compaction

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(o.spawned_at, $bucket, NULL), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.duration_s) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.duration_s) AS p90 FROM ah.v_spawn_outcome o WHERE $__timeFilter(o.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR o.parent_namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR o.parent_agent IN ($agent)) AND o.duration_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Spawn to completion per bucket (ah.v_spawn_outcome.duration_s).
spec.title: Spawn duration p50 / p90

spec.rawSql: SELECT b.label AS duration, count(o.*) AS spawns FROM (VALUES (1,'<1m',0,60),(2,'1-5m',60,300),(3,'5-15m',300,900),(4,'15-30m',900,1800),(5,'30-60m',1800,3600),(6,'1-2h',3600,7200),(7,'>2h',7200,1e9)) b(o,label,lo,hi) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.duration_s FROM ah.v_spawn_outcome o WHERE $__timeFilter(o.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR o.parent_namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR o.parent_agent IN ($agent)) AND o.duration_s IS NOT NULL) o ON o.duration_s >= b.lo AND o.duration_s < b.hi GROUP BY b.o, b.label ORDER BY b.o

spec.description: Completed spawns bucketed by wall time.
spec.title: Spawn duration distribution

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(p.resolved_model, p.requested_model, '(inherit)') || ' / ' || coalesce(p.reasoning_effort,'-') AS route, count(*) AS spawns FROM ah.subagent_spawn p JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = p.parent_session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

spec.description: resolved model x reasoning_effort, top 20.
spec.title: Spawns by model and effort

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ah.subagent_spawn p JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = p.parent_session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND p.completion_status IN ('failed','interrupted','killed')

spec.description: Spawns that did not complete cleanly.
spec.title: Failed / interrupted / killed

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p.spawned_at, $bucket, NULL), coalesce(p.resolved_model, p.requested_model, '(inherit)') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM ah.subagent_spawn p JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = p.parent_session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Spawns per bucket by the model the child actually ran.
spec.title: Spawns by resolved model

spec.rawSql: SELECT o.spawned_at, o.parent_namespace AS namespace, o.child_agent_type AS agent_type, o.resolved_model AS model, (CASE WHEN '$redact' = 'on' THEN '(redacted)' ELSE o.name END) AS name, (CASE WHEN '$redact' = 'on' THEN '(redacted)' ELSE o.description END) AS description, o.completion_status, o.lane_return_status, o.redo, o.duration_s, o.priced_cost_usd AS cost_usd, o.child_session_uid AS session_uid FROM ah.v_spawn_outcome o WHERE $__timeFilter(o.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR o.parent_namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR o.parent_agent IN ($agent)) AND (o.redo OR o.completion_status IN ('failed','interrupted','killed')) ORDER BY o.spawned_at DESC LIMIT 60

spec.description: Recent v_spawn_outcome rows with a non-completed status or redo=true. description is the spawn's short label, not the brief.
spec.title: Spawns that failed, were redone or interrupted

spec.rawSql: SELECT avg(o.redo::int) FROM ah.v_spawn_outcome o WHERE $__timeFilter(o.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR o.parent_namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR o.parent_agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Share of spawns re-issued for the same task within 2 h (ah.v_spawn_outcome.redo).
spec.title: Redo rate

spec.rawSql: SELECT resolved_model AS model, agent_type, spawns, completed, redo_rate, avg_duration_s, total_priced_cost_usd AS cost_usd, commits, ci_success_rate FROM ah.routing_report($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, (CASE WHEN '__all__' IN ($namespace) THEN NULL ELSE ARRAY[$namespace]::text[] END)) ORDER BY spawns DESC LIMIT 60

spec.description: ah.routing_report: spawns by resolved model and agent type, redo rate, child cost and the CI outcome of child commits.
spec.title: Model routing report

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ah.subagent_spawn p JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = p.parent_session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Subagent spawns (Claude Agent/Task calls, Codex spawn_agent) in range.
spec.title: Spawns

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(p.completion_status,'(none)') AS status, count(*) AS spawns FROM ah.subagent_spawn p JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = p.parent_session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: subagent_spawn.completion_status ((none) = no completion recorded yet, usually Codex).
spec.title: Completion status

spec.rawSql: SELECT t.namespace, t.agent, t.session_uid, (CASE WHEN '$redact' = 'on' AND ah.project_of(t.cwd) !~ '^\(' AND (ah.project_of(t.cwd) ~* '(__AH_PRIVATE_TERMS__)' OR NOT (CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(ah.project_of(t.cwd), ''), '^(https?://)?(github\.com/)?', '')) LIKE '%/%' THEN lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(ah.project_of(t.cwd), ''), '^(https?://)?(github\.com/)?', '')) = ANY (ARRAY['brotek-solutions/ha-addons', 'rknightion/.github', 'rknightion/arcane', 'rknightion/autopi-ha', 'rknightion/backlog-publishing', 'rknightion/bumblebee-catalog', 'rknightion/bumblebee-intune', 'rknightion/cf2otel', 'rknightion/chatgpt-exporter', 'rknightion/claude-notifications-go', 'rknightion/codex-lb', 'rknightion/codexlb2otel', 'rknightion/core', 'rknightion/fleet-management-operator', 'rknightion/gcx', 'rknightion/genai-otel-bridge', 'rknightion/grafana-aio11y-demo', 'rknightion/grafana-cloud-org-insights', 'rknightion/grafana-cloud-reference-examples', 'rknightion/grafana-cloud-vending-machine', 'rknightion/graph2otel', 'rknightion/grottrack', 'rknightion/intune-assignments-manager', 'rknightion/intuneomator', 'rknightion/k8s-monitoring-helm', 'rknightion/meraki-dashboard-exporter', 'rknightion/meraki-dashboard-ha', 'rknightion/mq-exporter-dist', 'rknightion/openbao-plugin-secrets-github', 'rknightion/opentelemetry-demo', 'rknightion/opnsense2otel', 'rknightion/paperless-ngx-dedupe', 'rknightion/polylens2otel', 'rknightion/profilarr', 'rknightion/rfc6035-2otel', 'rknightion/sagemcom-f3896-py', 'rknightion/sf2loki', 'rknightion/synthkit', 'rknightion/tailscale2otel', 'rknightion/third-party-patcher', 'rknightion/transceiver-exporter', 'rknightion/unpoller']) ELSE lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(ah.project_of(t.cwd), ''), '^(https?://)?(github\.com/)?', '')) = ANY (ARRAY['ha-addons', '.github', 'arcane', 'autopi-ha', 'backlog-publishing', 'bumblebee-catalog', 'bumblebee-intune', 'cf2otel', 'chatgpt-exporter', 'claude-notifications-go', 'codex-lb', 'codexlb2otel', 'core', 'fleet-management-operator', 'gcx', 'genai-otel-bridge', 'grafana-aio11y-demo', 'grafana-cloud-org-insights', 'grafana-cloud-reference-examples', 'grafana-cloud-vending-machine', 'graph2otel', 'grottrack', 'intune-assignments-manager', 'intuneomator', 'k8s-monitoring-helm', 'meraki-dashboard-exporter', 'meraki-dashboard-ha', 'mq-exporter-dist', 'openbao-plugin-secrets-github', 'opentelemetry-demo', 'opnsense2otel', 'paperless-ngx-dedupe', 'polylens2otel', 'profilarr', 'rfc6035-2otel', 'sagemcom-f3896-py', 'sf2loki', 'synthkit', 'tailscale2otel', 'third-party-patcher', 'transceiver-exporter', 'unpoller']) END)) THEN 'private repo' ELSE ah.project_of(t.cwd) END) AS project, t.sessions, t.turns_human, t.llm_calls, t.output, t.tool_calls, t.tool_errors, t.compactions, t.commits, t.pushes, t.first_event_at AS started FROM ah.v_session_tree t WHERE $__timeFilter(t.first_event_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR t.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR t.agent IN ($agent)) ORDER BY t.llm_calls DESC LIMIT 30

spec.description: ah.v_session_tree roots started in range, by LLM calls across the whole tree.
spec.title: Largest session trees

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(p.requested_type,'(unknown)') AS agent_type, count(*) AS spawns FROM ah.subagent_spawn p JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = p.parent_session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.spawned_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

spec.description: Recorded request type for Claude, Codex and pi spawns. (unknown) means no supported source or certain harness default was linked; top 20.
spec.title: Spawns by agent type

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(l.ts, $bucket, NULL), l.agent AS metric, sum(l.cache_read)::float/nullif(sum((coalesce(l.input_uncached,0) + coalesce(l.cache_read,0) + coalesce(l.cache_write_5m,0) + coalesce(l.cache_write_1h,0))),0) AS value FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: cache_read / all input per bucket and agent.
spec.title: Cache read share by agent

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(l.ts, $bucket, NULL), sum(l.input_uncached) AS "input (uncached)", sum(l.cache_read) AS "cache read", sum(l.cache_write_5m) AS "cache write 5m", sum(l.cache_write_1h) AS "cache write 1h", sum(l.output) AS output FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: llm_call tokens per bucket by class.
spec.title: Token classes

spec.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.context_tokens::float/l.context_window) FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND l.context_window > 0

spec.description: p50 of context_tokens / context_window over calls that report a window.
spec.title: Median context fill

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(l.ts, $bucket, NULL), CASE WHEN s.is_subagent THEN 'subagent' ELSE 'root' END || ' p50' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.context_tokens::float/l.context_window) AS value FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND l.context_window > 0 GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(l.ts, $bucket, NULL), CASE WHEN s.is_subagent THEN 'subagent' ELSE 'root' END || ' p90', percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.context_tokens::float/l.context_window) FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND l.context_window > 0 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: context_tokens / context_window per call, per bucket, split by session kind.
spec.title: Context fill p50 / p90: root vs subagent

spec.rawSql: SELECT sum(l.cache_write_1h)::numeric/nullif(sum(coalesce(l.cache_write_5m,0)+coalesce(l.cache_write_1h,0)),0) FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Share of cache-write tokens written with the 1-hour TTL (priced higher than 5 min).
spec.title: Cache writes (1h share)

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(l.effort,'(none)') AS effort, count(*) AS calls FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: llm_call.effort (Codex reasoning effort, Claude effort level).
spec.title: Calls by reasoning effort

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(l.ts, $bucket, NULL), coalesce(l.model,'(none)') AS metric, sum(l.output) AS value FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: llm_call.output per bucket and model.
spec.title: Output tokens by model

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(l.model,'(none)') AS model, count(*) AS calls, count(DISTINCT l.session_id) AS sessions, sum(l.output) AS output, round(avg(l.output)) AS avg_output, sum(l.reasoning) AS reasoning, sum(l.cache_read)::numeric/nullif(sum((coalesce(l.input_uncached,0) + coalesce(l.cache_read,0) + coalesce(l.cache_write_5m,0) + coalesce(l.cache_write_1h,0))),0) AS cache_share, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.context_tokens::float/nullif(l.context_window,0)) AS p90_ctx_fill, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.is_api_error) AS api_errors, max(l.ts) AS last_used FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 40

spec.description: Per model over the range: calls, sessions, token volume, average output per call, cache share and context fill.
spec.title: Model scoreboard

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(l.ts, $bucket, NULL), s.namespace AS metric, sum((coalesce(l.input_uncached,0) + coalesce(l.cache_read,0) + coalesce(l.cache_write_5m,0) + coalesce(l.cache_write_1h,0) + coalesce(l.output,0))) AS value FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: All token classes per bucket and namespace.
spec.title: Total tokens by namespace

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(l.output),0) FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Sum of llm_call.output in range (Codex output includes reasoning).
spec.title: Output tokens

spec.rawSql: SELECT sum(l.reasoning)::numeric/nullif(sum(l.output),0) FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: reasoning / output tokens (Codex reports reasoning separately; Claude does not).
spec.title: Reasoning share

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(l.stop_reason,'(none)') AS stop_reason, count(*) AS calls FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND l.agent='claude' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: stop_reason on Claude responses: tool_use, end_turn, max_tokens (truncated), refusal.
spec.title: Claude stop reasons

spec.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.ttft_ms) FROM ah.turn t JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = t.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.started_at) AND t.ttft_ms IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: p50 turn time to first token (ah.turn.ttft_ms).
spec.title: Median TTFT

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.started_at, $bucket, NULL), s.agent || ' p50' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.ttft_ms) AS value FROM ah.turn t JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = t.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.started_at) AND t.ttft_ms IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.started_at, $bucket, NULL), s.agent || ' p90', percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.ttft_ms) FROM ah.turn t JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = t.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.started_at) AND t.ttft_ms IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: ah.turn.ttft_ms per bucket.
spec.title: Time to first token p50 / p90 by agent

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.started_at, $bucket, NULL), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.duration_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.duration_ms) AS p90 FROM ah.turn t JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = t.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.started_at) AND t.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: ah.turn.duration_ms per bucket (complete turns).
spec.title: Turn duration p50 / p90

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(l.web_search_requests+l.web_fetch_requests),0) FROM ah.llm_call l JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(l.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Server-side web_search and web_fetch requests (Claude).
spec.title: Web search + fetch

spec.rawSql: SELECT c.tool_name AS tool, count(*) AS calls, sum(c.output_bytes) AS output_bytes, round(avg(c.output_bytes)) AS avg_bytes, max(c.output_bytes) AS max_bytes, sum(c.persisted_output_bytes) AS persisted_bytes FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY output_bytes DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30

spec.description: Output bytes each tool pushed back into context, with persisted (spilled to file) output.
spec.title: Context burn by tool

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Tool calls in range.
spec.title: Tool calls

spec.rawSql: SELECT category, source, namespace, tool_name AS tool, cmd_verb, (CASE WHEN '$redact' = 'on' THEN '(redacted)' ELSE reason END) AS reason, events, sessions, last_ts FROM ah.denials($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, (CASE WHEN '__all__' IN ($namespace) THEN NULL ELSE ARRAY[$namespace]::text[] END)) ORDER BY (category LIKE 'permission-rule%'), events DESC LIMIT 50

spec.description: ah.denials(since, namespaces): auto-mode blocks and user rejections first, then permission-rule hits (rules working).
spec.title: Denials

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND c.outcome='denied'

spec.description: outcome=denied (user rejection, auto-mode block or permission rule).
spec.title: Denied

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND c.outcome='error'

spec.description: outcome=error.
spec.title: Errors

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(f.ts, $bucket, NULL), f.error_class AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT c.started_at AS ts, s.namespace, s.agent, s.session_uid, c.tool_name AS tool, c.error_class, c.error_excerpt FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE c.error_class IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(o.started_at, o.completed_at), s.namespace, s.agent, s.session_uid, coalesce(nullif(o.cmd_verb, ''), o.item_type), o.error_class, o.error_excerpt FROM ah.tool_op o JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = o.session_id WHERE o.error_class IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(o.started_at, o.completed_at)) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))) f GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Failed tool calls and Codex operations per bucket by error_class: denied, timeout, interrupted, validation_error, not_found, fake_cell_wait (Codex wait on an exec cell the session never yielded), permission, network, nonzero_exit, tool_error, other.
spec.title: Failures by error class

spec.rawSql: SELECT f.ts, f.namespace, f.agent, f.tool, f.error_class, (CASE WHEN '$redact' = 'on' THEN '(redacted)' ELSE f.error_excerpt END) AS error_excerpt, f.session_uid FROM (SELECT c.started_at AS ts, s.namespace, s.agent, s.session_uid, c.tool_name AS tool, c.error_class, c.error_excerpt FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE c.error_class IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(o.started_at, o.completed_at), s.namespace, s.agent, s.session_uid, coalesce(nullif(o.cmd_verb, ''), o.item_type), o.error_class, o.error_excerpt FROM ah.tool_op o JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = o.session_id WHERE o.error_class IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(o.started_at, o.completed_at)) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))) f ORDER BY f.ts DESC LIMIT 200

spec.description: The latest 200 failures with error_excerpt (~500 chars from the first error-looking line, else the stderr tail). Excerpts are embedded, so semantic search finds similar failures.
spec.title: Recent failures

spec.rawSql: SELECT f.tool, f.error_class, count(*) AS failures, count(DISTINCT f.session_uid) AS sessions, max(f.ts) AS last_ts FROM (SELECT c.started_at AS ts, s.namespace, s.agent, s.session_uid, c.tool_name AS tool, c.error_class, c.error_excerpt FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE c.error_class IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(o.started_at, o.completed_at), s.namespace, s.agent, s.session_uid, coalesce(nullif(o.cmd_verb, ''), o.item_type), o.error_class, o.error_excerpt FROM ah.tool_op o JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = o.session_id WHERE o.error_class IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(o.started_at, o.completed_at)) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))) f GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 40

spec.description: Failed calls/ops per tool (Codex ops by command verb) and error_class, top 40.
spec.title: Failures by tool and class

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(c.started_at, $bucket, NULL), coalesce(nullif(c.tool_family,''),'(none)') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: builtin, custom (Codex shell/apply_patch), collaboration (spawn/wait), function, mcp.
spec.title: Tool calls by family

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(h.ts, $bucket, NULL), h.hook_event || ' ' || h.outcome AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM ah.hook_event h JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = h.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(h.ts) AND h.outcome <> 'success' AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Hook runs that errored, were cancelled, blocked or injected context/messages.
spec.title: Hook outcomes (non-success)

spec.rawSql: SELECT hook_event, hook_name, runs, sessions, coverage, p50_ms, p95_ms, max_ms, total_s, error_rate, blocked_rate, timeout_rate FROM ah.hook_latency($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, (CASE WHEN '__all__' IN ($namespace) THEN NULL ELSE ARRAY[$namespace]::text[] END)) ORDER BY total_s DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

spec.description: ah.hook_latency(since, namespaces). coverage = share of runs with a recorded duration.
spec.title: Hook latency

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(h.ts, $bucket, NULL), h.hook_event AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM ah.hook_event h JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = h.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(h.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Claude hook runs per bucket by hook event (Codex records none).
spec.title: Hook runs by event

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.ts, $bucket, NULL), sum(t.input_bytes) AS input, sum(t.output_bytes) AS output, sum(t.stdout_bytes) AS stdout, sum(t.stderr_bytes) AS stderr FROM ah.tool_io t WHERE $__timeFilter(t.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR t.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR t.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Bytes stored per bucket in ah.tool_io: input, model-visible output, stdout and stderr (UTF-8 bytes of the stored text).
spec.title: Tool I/O volume

spec.rawSql: SELECT t.tool_name AS tool, count(*) AS rows, sum(t.input_bytes) AS input, sum(t.output_bytes) AS output, sum(t.stdout_bytes) AS stdout, sum(t.stderr_bytes) AS stderr, avg((coalesce(t.output_truncated, false) OR coalesce(t.input_truncated, false))::int) AS truncated, coalesce(sum(jsonb_array_length(t.output_parts)) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(t.output_parts) = 'array'), 0) AS binary_parts FROM ah.tool_io t WHERE $__timeFilter(t.ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR t.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR t.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY output DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 40

spec.description: ah.tool_io per tool: rows, bytes of each stream, share truncated by the source, and binary parts (images, documents) kept as metadata only.
spec.title: Tool I/O by tool

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND c.mcp_server IS NOT NULL

spec.description: Calls to MCP servers.
spec.title: MCP calls

spec.rawSql: SELECT c.mcp_server, count(*) AS calls FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND c.mcp_server IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

spec.description: Calls per MCP server, top 20.
spec.title: MCP servers

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(c.output_bytes),0) FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent))

spec.description: Sum of tool output bytes: what tools pushed back into context.
spec.title: Tool output volume

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(c.started_at, $bucket, NULL), coalesce(nullif(c.tool_family,''),'(none)') AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.duration_ms) AS value FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND c.duration_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: p95 duration_ms per bucket and tool family.
spec.title: Tool duration p95 by family

spec.rawSql: SELECT source, namespace, tool_name AS tool, mcp_server, cmd_verb, denial_kind, (CASE WHEN '$redact' = 'on' THEN '(redacted)' ELSE reason END) AS reason, denials, sessions, retried_ok, retried_ok_rate, last_ts FROM ah.permission_candidates($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, (CASE WHEN '__all__' IN ($namespace) THEN NULL ELSE ARRAY[$namespace]::text[] END)) ORDER BY denials DESC LIMIT 50

spec.description: ah.permission_candidates: denied calls that were retried and then succeeded. A high retried_ok_rate is a candidate for an allow rule.
spec.title: Permission rule candidates

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(c.started_at, $bucket, NULL), avg((c.outcome='error')::int) AS error, avg((c.outcome='denied')::int) AS denied, avg((c.outcome='timeout')::int) AS timeout, avg((c.outcome='interrupted')::int) AS interrupted FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Share of tool calls per bucket that errored, were denied, timed out or were interrupted.
spec.title: Tool call outcome rates

spec.rawSql: SELECT agent, tool_name AS tool, mcp_server, calls, error_rate, denial_rate, interrupt_rate, p50_ms, p95_ms FROM ah.tool_reliability($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, (CASE WHEN '__all__' IN ($namespace) THEN NULL ELSE ARRAY[$namespace]::text[] END)) WHERE ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR agent IN ($agent)) ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 60

spec.description: ah.tool_reliability(since, namespaces): calls, error/denial/interrupt rates and latency. Top 60 by calls.
spec.title: Tool reliability

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND c.outcome='timeout'

spec.description: outcome=timeout.
spec.title: Timeouts

spec.rawSql: SELECT c.tool_name, count(*) AS calls FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

spec.description: Top 20 tools by calls in range.
spec.title: Top tools

spec.rawSql: SELECT verb, sum(n) AS calls FROM (SELECT c.meta->>'cmd_verb' AS verb, count(*) AS n FROM ah.tool_call c JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = c.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.started_at) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) AND c.meta ? 'cmd_verb' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT o.cmd_verb, count(*) FROM ah.tool_op o JOIN ah.session s ON s.id = o.session_id WHERE $__timeFilter(o.started_at) AND o.cmd_verb IS NOT NULL AND o.cmd_verb <> '' AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR s.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR s.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

spec.description: First command verb of Claude Bash calls and Codex command executions, top 25.
spec.title: Shell command verbs

spec.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(c.agent_type,'(unknown)') || ' / ' || coalesce(c.agent_type_source,'unknown') AS type_source, count(*) AS sessions FROM ah.session c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.first_event_at) AND c.is_subagent AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR c.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR c.agent IN ($agent)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 30

spec.description: Child session agent type and provenance: explicit from recorded launch or child metadata; default only when the harness default is certain. Unknown remains visible.
spec.title: Child types and source

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM ah.session c WHERE $__timeFilter(c.first_event_at) AND c.is_subagent AND c.agent_type IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR c.namespace IN ($namespace)) AND ('__all__' IN ($agent) OR c.agent IN ($agent))

ELSE coalesce(repo_slug,'(unknown repo)') || '/' || CASE WHEN loop_number IS NULL THEN coalesce(campaign_slug,'run') ELSE 'loop' || loop_number::text END END || ' · ' || to_char(launch_ts, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text, launch_ts FROM ah.v_loop_summary WHERE $__timeFilter(launch_ts) AND ('__all__' IN ($repo) OR repo_slug IN ($repo)) AND ('__all__' IN ($namespace) OR namespace IN ($namespace)) ORDER BY launch_ts DESC LIMIT 100), labelled AS (SELECT __value,__text,launch_ts FROM choices UNION ALL SELECT '', 'No loops in selected range', NULL::timestamptz WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM choices)) SELECT __value,__text FROM labelled ORDER BY launch_ts DESC NULLS LAST
